message:
Evaluate complete Attention winner/rejection control with unbiased arbitration

Add bounded elastic winner feedback, grouped uniform-rank selection, rejection fair-bit prefetch ablation, independent cycle oracles, fixed synthesis tops and DC/PT scripts. Validate 124 RTL cases/422800 cycles and 3 matched-cap zero-delay mapped replays; map 8 tops to local 55nm SS library for area only. Preserve failures/private raw evidence and register the v2 circuit assessment. STA and power remain unrun.

Refs #198
